description: Ask the owner to open a successor VerificationRound after a finalized round of your Goal. The owner applies the same admission and shared cap as an automatic recheck and does not run the check itself. Under every-step confirmation the call returns a rework-request card instead of opening the round, and the person's approval applies it as an agent. Parameters name the predecessor round and the reason; onlyIfSourceChanged narrows admission to a source that changed.

parameters.predecessorRoundRef: The finalized round whose successor should run.
parameters.predecessorRoundRef.goalId: The round's goal id; it must be your Goal.
parameters.predecessorRoundRef.runId: The Run id the round belongs to.
parameters.onlyIfSourceChanged: When true, the owner opens a successor only if the source changed since the predecessor; omit for the owner's default.
parameters.reason: Why the result should be examined again; the owner's reason text.
parameters.acknowledgement: The Session message this answers; omit unless the request answers one.
parameters.basisMessage: A question your line can read that another line formally answered, as the new basis; judge yourself whether the answer gives one, else omit. A Session message only, not an artifact.
parameters.expected: Exact W1 pins; omit rather than guess a fresh revision. Read the predecessor round revision from its own VerificationRound card (the Task card's checks relation names the rounds), not from the Goal or Task card; the optional TaskReworkRefusal pin is the current reverify refusal.
parameters.expected[].revision: The exact version the caller saw; a mismatch is rejected with the current record.
